incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-runtime-usw2 check=latency_p95 value=1.85s threshold=1.2s incident=PD-88200

Sam L: ack
Sam L: i'm looking... dashboards loading
Sam L: p95 up on runtime-pool-3 in us-west-2, concurrent_sessions doubled
Priya (SRE): i see a surge tagged `staging-e2e-load` ~40s ago, could be internal traffic
Sam L: no infra deploys in last 20m

```
curl "https://metrics.redwood.internal/query?m=latency_p95&svc=inference-runtime-usw2&from=-5m"
```
Jon P: earlier this morning we saw similar 03:14 UTC pattern, might be pod warmups
Sam L: autoscaler logs show pod restarts 03:21-03:24
Sam L: logs snippet:
```
[03:21:14] runtime-pool-3/instance-7 OOMKilled
[03:21:22] runtime-pool-3/instance-8 restarted
[03:22:05] autoscaler: scaled_up +2
```
Sam L: queueing while new workers initialized caused p95 blips
Maria R: can we silence to reduce noise while investigating?
Sam L: silencing PD for 10m — /pd-silence PD-88200 10m "temp internal load test"
pagerduty: PD-88200 silenced for 10 minutes by Sam L
incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved PD-88200 duration=52s reason="metric recovered"
Priya (SRE): it re-fired once after silence ended for ~25s then resolved — looks like flapping
Sam L: creating follow-up ticket to tune alert and ignore test traffic
Sam L: INC-2402 created: "Reduce p95 noise: ignore staging-e2e-load tag and require 2-sample confirmation" assigned to SRE
Jon P: adding runbook note: on PD fires with internal tags, silence 10m, check autoscaler churn and pod OOMs, then escalate if customer keys show latency
Maria R: did customers see impact?
Sam L: checked external API-key traces -> customer p95 stayed <=800ms, so NO_CUSTOMER_IMPACT
Priya (SRE): marking INC-2402 as NO_IMPACT_CUSTOMERS and attaching timeline + logs
Sam L: leaving thread notes and closing once the alert rule change lands. :thumbsup:
